title: Agent Engineering Skills — eval case schema
description: Schema for an individual eval case (routing or findings). A case describes a real-world situation the agent may encounter, the skills it should (and should not) select, and the findings/evidence expectations. Runtime is deterministic; it does not require an external model.

task.description: The situation the agent must route for / find bugs in.

context.description: Facts about the system under test (may include real bugs).

risk.description: Matches the skill-budget risk scale in plan.md § 7.1.

expected_findings.description: Bugs / defects the agent should surface. Empty for negative (no-bug) cases.

forbidden_claims.description: Claims the agent must NOT assert. Especially: no confirming without evidence.

expected_confidence.description: Map of finding id → confidence level the consolidator should produce.

negative.description: true when the correct answer is to find no bug (a negative case).
